bibliographic_record.title: Koopman Reduced Order Modeling with Confidence Bounds
bibliographic_record.authors: Mohr, R.; Fonoberova, M.; Mezic, I.

verbatim_excerpt: Submitted 27 Sep 2022; v3 27 Mar 2025; MSC 47B33, 15A18, 62F25, 62M20. 'The reduced order model is constructed using a finite number of Koopman eigenvalues and modes, while the rest of spectrum is treated as a noise process. This noise process is used to extract the confidence bounds.'
